chunks: Whenever a group passes by a group of people, it would suffice for them if one of them gives the greeting.
And when a greeting is given to a group of people and they are a group, it would suffice them if one of them responds.

key_terms.أجزأهم: It suffices them; a jurisprudential term indicating that the minimum obligation has been fulfilled
key_terms.الجماعة: A group/congregation; used here to denote a plurality of travelers or people in company
key_terms.يردّ: Responds/replies; the obligation of responding to the salam greeting
key_terms.يسلّم: Gives the greeting of salam (السلام عليكم); the initiation of the Islamic greeting

ai.seo_question: If one person in a group gives the salam greeting, does it count for all of them?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a jurisprudential ruling on the communal nature of the Islamic greeting (salam). The hadith teaches that the obligation of initiating a greeting and responding to one is a collective duty (fard kifayah) — when one member of a group fulfills it, the obligation is discharged for all. This ruling reflects the Islamic principle that social obligations affecting the community do not require individual action from each person, so long as the communal duty is collectively met.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Ibn Bukeyr, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Whenever a group passes by a group of people, it would suffice for them if one of them was to greet (السَّلَامُ);
and when a group is greeted upon, and they are a group, it would suffice them if one of them was to respond’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from ibn Bukayr from certain individuals of his people from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “If one person from a group passing by another group offers the greeting of peace it is sufficient for all
and so also is for an answer if only one person from the stationary group responds.”
